name: Seeing Forever
source:
14 year old witch Melody Sera is impatient about where her journey as a witch is going next.

She's ahead of her class. Bored by everything around her and just wants to know what else there is for her.

She's found through less than socially acceptable means the help of a local psychic.

One wintery day, with her reluctant familiar Rascal at her side, a meeting is arranged to discuss her future. 

Will this meeting be the spark to ignite her true purpose or will this path for knowledge take her down in spectacular flames? 

[From [url=https://sagemintiart.itch.io/seeing-forever/]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
14岁女巫梅洛迪·塞拉 (Melody Sera) 对她作为女巫的旅程的下一步走向感到不耐烦。

她在班上领先。对周围的一切感到厌倦，只想知道她还有什么。

在当地灵媒的帮助下，她通过不太为社会所接受的方式找到了自己。

一个冬日，在她身边不情愿的熟悉的Rascal的陪伴下，我们安排了一次会议来讨论她的未来。

这次会面会成为点燃她真正目标的火花，还是这条求知之路会让她在壮观的火焰中灭亡？

[来自[url=https://sagemintiart.itch.io/seeing-forever/]itch.io[/url]]
